name: How do I choose between moisture-resistant drywall and cement board for bathrooms?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between moisture-resistant drywall and cement board for bathrooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: The choice between moisture-resistant drywall and cement board depends on the specific area within the bathroom. Moisture-resistant drywall is suitable for general bathroom walls and ceilings that experience humidity but not direct water exposure. For areas like shower and tub surrounds, or behind bathroom tiles that will be regularly exposed to water, cement board is the superior choice. Cement board is impervious to water and provides a stable, mold-resistant base for tiling, whereas moisture-resistant drywall can eventually degrade with consistent water saturation. Often, both materials are used in different zones of the same bathroom.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use moisture-resistant drywall for general bathroom walls, but cement board is superior and necessary for areas with direct water exposure like shower surrounds.
